settings.heading: Information display
settings.description: Frankie is a 9-year-old equestrian who has been riding since early childhood and lives on a small family farm with seven horses. She regularly rides her ponies Merlin and Humphrey while developing her jumping and Eventing skills. Frankie trains year-round, helps with daily horse care in all weather conditions, rides farm trails, and even built her own cross-country course at home.

settings.heading: Q1：Your recent Venustas heated apparel.
settings.body: Frankie currently uses the Venustas heated puffy vest for winter riding, lessons, horse chores, trail riding, and outdoor training during extremely cold Canadian winters.

settings.heading: Q2: How does Venustas heated apparel change your lifestyle?
settings.body: Venustas heated apparel has made winter riding and outdoor horse care much more comfortable and enjoyable for Frankie. It allows her to stay warm without bulky layers, so she can move freely, ride safely, and focus on her pony instead of the cold. It has also improved her willingness to ride and help with chores during harsh winter weather, making daily horse responsibilities less stressful and more enjoyable for the whole family.

settings.heading: Q3: Which part most appealing to you about Venustas?
settings.body: The most appealing part is the ability to provide real warmth without restricting movement. The vest layers smoothly under riding gear and a crash vest while still allowing proper riding position and effective movement in the saddle. The easy-to-use battery system, visible temperature indicator, comfort, and practicality for winter riding are also highly appreciated.

settings.heading: Q4: How do you feel about Venustas heated apparel?
settings.body: The experience with Venustas heated apparel has been extremely positive and transformative. The heated vest has changed winter riding from something Frankie struggled through into something she genuinely enjoys again. It keeps her warm, comfortable, happy, and focused during riding lessons, outdoor training, and winter horse chores, even in temperatures as low as –30°C.

settings.heading: Q5: The reason to be our V+ Master.
settings.body: Venustas supports Frankie’s ability to continue pursuing her passion for horses year-round despite extremely challenging winter conditions. The products align closely with the family’s values of responsibility, resilience, consistency, and showing up every day for the things they love. As a young equestrian who rides, trains, and cares for horses through harsh Canadian winters, Frankie genuinely relies on Venustas products as an important part of her daily riding and outdoor lifestyle.
